Letter from Šamaš-ṭāb to Ilak-niʾid -- a composite transliteration

ETCSL c.3.3.08 — converted from ETCSL TEI XML (Oxford Text Archive item 2518, revised edition Oct 2006; CC BY-NC-SA 3.0).
Source file: c.3.3.08.xml; web: https://etcsl.orinst.ox.ac.uk/cgi-bin/etcsl.cgi?text=c.3.3.08

Conventions (this conversion): ETCSL ASCII c/j/h → š/ĝ/ḫ; sign indices as subscripts (du₁₁); determinatives in {braces} ({d}, {ki}, {ĝeš});
[ ] = restored; ⸢ ⸣ = damaged (ETCSL web shows /…); ? = uncertain reading; ⟨ ⟩ = scribal omission supplied; « » = scribal addition;
(…) parenthesised italic notes = manuscript variants (“1 ms. has instead:”, “1 ms. adds:”); … = lost word(s), X = illegible sign.
Line numbers = ETCSL composite line numbers (with segment letters where the composition has segments).

  1. {m}i-la-ak-ni-id u₃-na-dug₄
  2. {m}{d}UTU-DUG₃-e na-ab-be₂-a
  3. kaskal itid 1(DIŠ) ud 15-kam ud IM-za ḫe₂-bi₂-DU
  4. šag₄ ni-qum{ki}-ma-še₃ (1 ms. has instead: ni-qum{ki}-ma-ta) a-na-še-am₃ itid-da ud 3(EŠ₅)-kam-ma-bi
  5. a₂ aĝ₂-ĝa₂-zu na-ma-tum₃
  6. bar-zu en₃ bi₂-in-tar ĝiri₃-zu si ba-ab-sa₂
  7. 2(MIN) anše-ĝiš-am₃ kug-bi 4(LIMMU₅) giĝ₄
  8. 1(DIŠ) šag₄-ga-du₃ gada kug-bi MAŠ giĝ₄
  9. a₂ {ĝiš}ma₂-zu 1(DIŠ) giĝ₄
  10. a₂ mas-su {ĝiš}ma₂-zu (1 ms. has instead: ma-zu ma-zum) (another ms. has instead: {ĝiš}ma₂-zu ma₂-zu) 1(DIŠ) 1/3 giĝ₄-am₃
  11. a bi₂-si-ig
  12. zig₃-ga dili-dili-zu šag₄-bi-ta nu-ĝal₂
  13. 2(AŠ.AŠ) gun₂ siki da-gal-tum-ma (1 ms. has instead: da-ga-al-tum-ma) (another ms. has instead: da-ga-AN-tum-ma) kug-bi ḫa-ra-da-šid
  14. niĝ₂-sam₂-ma kug 1(DIŠ) 2/3 (2 mss. have instead: 2/3) ma-na-kam nagga-a gi₄-ma-ni-ib
  15. {na₄}du₈-ši-a {na₄}nir₇-igi {na₄}nir₇-muš-ĝir₂ (2 mss. have instead: {na₄}nir₇-muš-su₃-ud)
  16. ĝeštug₂-zu ḫe₂-en-ĝal₂
  17. kug dili-dili-zu saĝ-bi ḫa-ra-ab-dab₅ im-ma ḫu-mu-ra-ab-tag (1 ms. has instead: ḫu-mu-ra-ab-ak)
  18. ud-da-ta a₂ aĝ₂-ĝa₂-zu ḫe₂-em-tum₃
  19. a-ma-ru-kam
